newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Dec 23.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Dec 23.

text.p: * AT&T Corp said it named Gail McGovern head of its consumer long distance unit after the resignation of Joseph Nacchio, a 26-year veteran at the U.S. phone giant, who left to join Qwest Communications Corp.
AT&T shares closed off 1/4 at 39-3/8 on Friday.
* American General Corp is expected to make a bid of $665 million, or $39 per share, for Home Beneficial Corp, according to the Wall Street Journal.
Home Beneficial shares closed at 29-1/4. American General shares closed at 40-1/4.
* Conrail Inc said its board rejected a takeover offer of $115 a share from Norfolk Southern in favor of its planned merger with CSX Inc.

* Donnkenny Inc, the apparel maker, said the Securities and Exchange Commission is conducting a formal investigation into its financial statements and trading of the company's securities, the Wall Street Journal reported.
